ticket.summary: Repeat kitchen-branch drain clog (3rd this year, snaked Jan and May) — draining slowly with gurgling, no other fixtures affected; camera inspection + snaking booked to find root cause.
mitigation_advice: Minimize use of the kitchen line tonight — no dishwasher, no disposal, run water sparingly so the sink doesn't overflow (no playbook entry applies; slow drain, not an active leak or sewage backup)
Confirmed no cross-fixture symptoms (toilets/laundry/bath clear), so no main-line/sewage protocol needed

quote_lines.description: Camera inspection of kitchen branch line to identify recurrence cause

ticket.customer_message: That's actually good news — since your toilets, laundry and bathroom are all fine, the main line is clear. The problem is the kitchen branch, and a third clog in one year almost always means grease/soap scale rebuilding on the pipe wall, or a sag/damaged section catching debris. Snaking punches a hole through it and it re-closes in a few months. So this time it's snake PLUS camera: Camera inspection (DIAG) $89 + Kitchen drain snaking (DRAIN-SNAKE-KITCHEN) $179 = $268 total, about 2 hours. If the camera shows something bigger (power auger or a damaged section), the tech shows you the footage and quotes before doing extra work. I've got you down for tomorrow, Tue Sept 1 at 3:00 PM. Keep it light on that sink until then — no dishwasher, no disposal, run water sparingly. Reply 'yes' to confirm, or I can move you to a morning.
